verdict.rationale: Before installing, `skills add <repo> --list` shows each skill's name and trigger description without installing anything, and a hands-on probe confirms this works with no account (gh-19, probe-rt-2). After installing, skills are written as plain files to `./<agent>/skills/` (or a canonical copy via symlinks) and can be enumerated with `skills list`, so they are readable on disk. However, the pre-install view is only names and descriptions, not the full SKILL.md body or the bundled scripts the spec allows (docs-13). Missing for 10: pre-install file-level listing or preview of full instructions and bundled scripts, a documented post-install command to inspect skill contents, and independent corroboration of a full-content review workflow.
